biography: Airbnb opens the door to interesting places to live, even if it's just for a night. Share your experiences with #airbnb. Book a home from our feed:

Head any direction from this Washington state treehouse, and you’ll find something extraordinary to explore. 
A five-mile stroll north gets you to quaint village-within-the-city Fairhaven, find the majestic Skagit River Valley 20 minutes south, head east for the waterfalls of the North Cascades, or venture west to board a ferry to the San Juan Islands. #TreehouseTuesday

Click the link in our bio to check out this listing's nature-inspired design.

Photo cred: @moneal
Beauty is the language spoken in Tokyo’s Arisugawa-no-miya Memorial Park. #LiveThere with a stroll around the grounds alongside your neighbors.

Don't just watch castles. Live There. (🐉 not included.) #GameOfThrones
#LiveThere

Ah Venice - "one half of me is yours..." The words of William Shakespeare have transported us to other worlds. Worlds filled with excitement, tragedy, beauty and hope, and it's the experiences where we encounter such vivid emotions that stick with us for years to come, and that shape us into the people we become.

Click the link in our bio and you could discover the world Shakespeare brought to life so magically in The Merchant of Venice over 400 years ago.

With a view of the English sea and countryside landscape, this eco-friendly treehouse makes it easy to remember why we celebrate #EarthDay.

A recent Airbnb study revealed shared home stays in Europe consume 78% less energy and 48% less water than hotels, per guest, per night. This little home, with its sustainable process for waste recycling, including a composting toilet, is a perfect example of that.

Click the link in our bio to check out all of its green features.

By sharing and respecting resources, we can work together to repair and preserve Earth. Hosts and guests on Airbnb do this by sharing homes while traveling, which generates lower rates of water use, and less greenhouse gas and waste. Hosts and guests are also sharing eco-friendly habits with each other: 89% of European and 61% of North American hosts provide recycling options for their guests.

This #EarthDay, celebrate by staying in a sustainable home. 
Click the link in our bio to see this space's eco-friendly features, including a charging station for electric cars. 
Photo cred: @christianescario

Some of Anne’s guests have stayed in her beachfront Malibu condo so many times, they send her Christmas cards every year. And it’s easy to love her eclectic 1920s spot with its ocean views from the living room, but it’s Anne’s hospitality that keeps guests coming back. After living here 22 years, she can tell you which fruit at the organic market across the street will be the most ripe, and which booths are a must-shop at the open-air Malibu Country Mart.

Wake up to the sounds of the waves, then check out a local coffee shop. Click the link in our bio to see where Anne and other local hosts suggest you explore next. 
#LiveThere
#airbnbhoststories
Are we on vacation in L.A.? Or do we call L.A. home? When you #LiveThere, even for a night, it can be a little bit of both at the same time. #LiveThere

Live a classic Californian lifestyle in this beach lodge. Unwind beside the backyard fire pit, or take a short walk to the Channel Islands Harbor where you can rent your preferred mode of water transportation: kayaks, paddle boards, jet skis, or boats.

Check out more of this rustic-glam home by clicking the link in our bio.

#AirbnbInteriors

This Asheville, North Carolina open concept loft invites you to take on a new perspective. Try out a new view during your own little moment of zen, or spot something unexpected while admiring the local street art in the alley below.

Click the link in our bio to see what else guests are saying about this friendly loft and its host.

Photo cred: @carlymarieyoga

#BelongAnywhere

Enjoy your #Airbnb, @justinbieber.

"What truly makes Ireland special, beyond its beauty, is the sense of belonging that people feel towards it. It’s an unassuming, soulful place; welcoming and familiar, where the magic is in the subtlest and most ordinary of details. A wink. A nod. A smile. 
For me, being an Irish host is about being kin, welcoming people as though they’re family. As though they’re home. As though they never left." Happy #StPatricksDay Eugene, and to each and every one of the Irish Airbnb community 🍀

#AirbnbHostStories

It isn't every day you find a backyard swimming pool in Nicaragua, which makes this private courtyard even more of an oasis. The hosts’ pup clearly agrees. 
Cool off here after a day exploring the local market that’s been operating since 1892, or taking a horse and carriage history tour through Granada’s city center.

Can’t get enough of this lively space? Click the link in our bio for more.

Photo cred: @sharelaude

Perhaps one of the best parts about spending a night on the west coast is getting to see the sunset. From this 20-foot high perch you also get a view of Washington’s Hood Canal as you watch the sun sink behind the Olympic Mountains.

Click the link in our bio to get a peek at the private beach just below this treehouse.

At this Tulum, Mexico escape, getting back to nature means waking up to songs of tropical birds in the surrounding acres of jungle and welcoming the sun’s rays from your outdoor shower.

It’s easy to get to know the locals – this hideaway is a three minute walk from Francisco Uh May, the neighboring Mayan village where shops burst with the colors of handmade dream catchers, wood carvings, and woven baskets.

Already imagining yourself in this Caribbean paradise? Click the link in our bio to see more.

Photo cred: @quizzie

This beautifully conserved Georgian style house is nearly 300 years old, but centered in one of London's most popular locations – Spitalfields, in the East End. Walk to famous landmarks like Old Spitalfields Market, where you’ll find vintage treasures, an array of globally-inspired food.

Click the link in our bio to get a closer look at all the restoration details.

Photo cred: @15princelet

Be inspired by the history in and around this Austin, Texas casita. Smack dab in the middle of long-established Hyde Park, you’ll find hip local cafés like Mother’s just blocks away from iconic, grassy-knolled Shipe Park.

Click the link in our bio for a closer look at this little hideaway.

#SXSW

Live like the queen or king of the jungle with a private swimming pool, outdoor shower, and fresh banana pancakes from the nearby café.

This luxurious villa is in Ubud, Bali, Indonesia, which is surrounded by rainforest and terraced rice paddies from which the tops of Hindu temples and shrines peek out.

Click the link in our bio to explore more of this tropical escape.

Photo cred: @thenomadicpeople

Throughout #WomensHistoryMonth, we continue to celebrate the amazing women around the world whose impactful work is making a difference.

Michelle always knew she wanted to use her passion for connecting people to make a difference in others’ lives, but she also enjoyed her successful engineering career. After becoming an Airbnb SuperHost, she had the assurance that she’s great with people, and extra income that gave her the support to try something new. Combining her experience and passion, she established a program for Hackbright Academy, a developer bootcamp for women, and now helps graduates of the Galvanize Fullstack engineering program achieve their best outcomes.

When you step into a space curated by two creative people, you’ll notice pattern combinations you never would have thought of, and whitewashed walls glowing from the light of handmade fixtures. You’ll find that and more in this cozy Portland home.

Start your day with freshly roasted pour over coffee and a chat with your imaginative hosts, then set out on foot to explore the neighborhood. Take in the quaint tree-lined streets as you make your way to the McMenamins Kennedy School, a refurbished space whose classrooms have been revamped into a brewery, movie theater, gallery, and more.

Click the link in our bio to see the other delightful details in this creative listing.

Photo Cred: @alliebrooke

For more than a century, the world has come together on International Women’s Day to celebrate the achievements of extraordinary women, and to press forward in the ongoing fight for gender equality.

Host GeunHyang wanted to take on the traditional role of stay-at-home mom, but still pursue her dream of running a guest house. She found her solution in opening the family’s South Korean apartment on Airbnb. Through hosting, she gets to experience different cultures while staying at home with her children. GeunHyang’s family has been so happy with the entrepreneurial idea that she says her daughters seem to get along better with the guests than she does.

See how Airbnb is helping to empower women around the world through our partnership with @VitalVoices and @GlobalFundWomen.

#InternationalWomensDay

International Women’s Day is a reminder to celebrate the social, economic, cultural and political achievements of women around the world. Though there’s still progress to be made, women are more and more being recognized for their important work.

Host Nicole’s work is helping disadvantaged and at-risk youth figure out what they want to do with their lives through her non-profit. She says, "Impact is something that I feel was naturally ingrained in me at a young age.” As a single mom and the sole caregiver and support to her daughter, hosting allowed her bridge the gap between graduating and getting her non-profit off the ground. Nicole says “Airbnb has been a gift” that helps her support her community by guiding students to live a "purposeful, happy life that positively affects society." See how Airbnb is helping to empower women around the world through our partnership with @VitalVoices and @globalfundwomen.

Today, on International Women’s Day, we celebrate the women hosts who've opened their homes on Airbnb. The income they earn helps with everything from sending kids to school, to living independent lifestyles, to pursuing passions. 
For host Bruna, her passion means weaving creativity into all aspects of her life. Bruna believes anyone can be an artist, which is why she’s turned her home into a place where people from all over the world can come and create. Once just a house she lived in alone, it's now "a concert stage, a theater, a restaurant, or even a cinema,” and because of all that, a unique stay for her Airbnb guests.

The extra income from Airbnb has allowed Bruna to support her own creative interests outside her home, too. She works for an agency helping brands tell their stories through content and cultural events.

See how Airbnb is helping to empower women around the world through our partnership with @VitalVoices and @GlobalFundWomen.

After running her own restaurant for 20 years in Darlinghurst, Sydney, Jeanne-Marie knows a thing or two about hospitality and of course, Sydney Mardi Gras - “It’s a beautiful celebration and was always a busy time for my restaurant with amazing people from all walks of life coming through the doors”. Now an Airbnb Host “the amazing people are staying as guests in my home!” #HostWithPride

Even the smallest details help make you feel like you belong. Our Sydney community armed with rainbows and glitter are getting ready to celebrate and #HostWithPride this Mardi Gras 
Photo cred: James Horan

The calm before the (glitter) storm. 
Sometimes it’s the simple things, Mardi Gras mornings are for exactly that. A time to reflect and celebrate how far we have come. #HostWithPride

Sydney Gay and Lesbian Mardi Gras has long been one of the world's most spectacular celebrations of pride, diversity and belonging.

38 years ago, a small group of people in Sydney led a march to promote equality and advocate for change. Today, 500,000 people from all over the world will line Sydney’s Oxford Street to do the same and just like every year before, will do so with pride. #BelongAnywhere

And if you still need more encouragement, #LiveThere by raising a glass of wine to the 360 degree view of vineyards, horse farms, rolling hills and forests from 30 feet up in the air. #TreehouseTuesday

At the foot of Hunter Mountain sits this sleepy 7-bedroom Catskills country house. To #LiveThere is to be just a minute to the entrance to the slopes, where three separate mountains are ready to be skied, snowboarded, and tubed down.

Dreaming of your own snowy expedition? Click the link in our bio for a roundup of powder-filled stays.

Photo cred: @allybmartin

Harlem is "a place where people will smile and say hello, the streets are vibrant, and the food scene is top notch," says Craig, who considers himself a Harlem Ambassador. As an Airbnb Host, he's dedicated to showing people the rich culture of his neighborhood. "My goal for guests," he says, "is to really see beyond stereotypes of Harlem" and, like him, be open to the vibrant culture that exists here. #AirbnbHostStories

Click the link in our bio to see Craig's apartment, a culmination of many cultural inspirations.

While traveling through Cuba recently, dancer @shaunevaristo had no problem with the fact he doesn’t know Spanish. "Though I can't speak the same language, dance is always one we can talk to each other.” During his trip, he found inspiration everywhere. From a performance group who uses their bodies and handmade instruments to create their soundtracks, to a jam-packed record store hidden in the back of a shop.

Sitting on his host family’s porch reflecting on the amazing experience, he and his friend @toogiesaurs agree “This trip to Cuba was one of the best trips of my life... My heart and brain are on the verge of exploding."

#LiveThere by asking your host for directions to this secret cove which is reached by a short hike over lava rocks and past waterfalls. Roughly the size of a large swimming pool, the calm waters are home to small fish and views you won’t soon forget. Photo cred: @thechloeroth 
Want to find a private lagoon of your own? Click the link in our bio.

The entryway wall of Nan’s Brooklyn brownstone is covered with photos of friends. Some she got to know over just a few days, others, like Simon from England, she’s met up with all the way in Paris for a tea. But all were guests she met on Airbnb, while hosting in her peaceful garden apartment.

Nan wanted to commemorate the special memories her guests helped her create, and came up with the idea to photograph each of them on the steps of the house. And as memento of their stay, she gave them a copy to remember her by.

See all of Nan’s portraits on her Instagram @toasthomecooking, and click the link in our bio to check out the brownstone where they all stayed.  #AirbnbHostStories

This open air villa in Ubud, Bali is brimming with soul. From coconuts within reach in the backyard to a private pool, shared only with a cheerful monkey statue. #LiveHere by starting your morning with a visit to the local market where you’ll find the the freshest fruit you’ve ever tasted, and quite possibly the friendliest locals you’ve ever met.

Find your place of bliss by clicking the link in our bio.

Photo cred: @_himandshe_

It’s called Koh Lanta Old Town for a reason. Though this fishing village is one of the region’s most culturally diverse areas, the day-to-day Thai life is similar to what it was when the town was founded a century ago. The 100 year old, teak-wood-lined streets lead the way to cafes and shops, eventually ending at eight long beaches where the sunsets are just as breathtaking as this dazzling island.

#LiveHere and get a taste of local life. To find your own coastal getaway by clicking the link in our bio.

Photo cred: @bergstrvm

Helping spread and fund education in Africa is as simple as visiting Austin, TX thanks to Chad’s charitable idea. In 2007, on a trip working with African refugees, he was surprised at the lack of educational opportunities and made increasing them his life’s mission.

The money he makes hosting on Airbnb goes directly to educational foundations in Sierra Leone, Kenya, and South Africa. Next, he plans to buy and rent a home in Cape Town, where guests can experience the South African culture while supporting educational opportunities locally.

Click the link in our bio to check out the apartment that’s more than just a place to stay.

When you're on an island like Hawaii, surrounded by water, the Pacific Ocean is your front yard ... and your backyard. #LiveThere by ditching your shoes as soon as you check in, and letting yourself be lulled into an afternoon nap by the gentle rustle of the palm trees.

Find your own seaside getaway by clicking the link in our bio.

photo cred: @tashaabear

If you never had a treehouse as a kid, here’s your chance as an adult, complete with a slide. #LiveThere in this cozy cabin in the air, made from a reclaimed barn, and situated in 100 acres of Ontario, Canada gorgeousness. If ever you have the desire to come down from your perch, cozy up in front of a crackling outdoor fire.

Want $100 off your own treehouse stay? Click the link in our bio to explore spots around the world.
